questions.q: Study the graph and find what is the maximum percentage increase of tea from the previous year to the next year. 2020 2021 2022 2023 milk 14 15 16 18 coffee 14 13 16 18 tea 13 15 17 20
questions.solution: Tea increases are 2/13,2/15 and 3/17. The largest is 3/17×100≈17.65%.

questions.q: A man's pension on retirement from service is equal to half the average salary during the last 3 years of his service. His salary from 1-1-1983 is ₹380 per month, with increment of ₹ 40 due on 1-10-83, 1-10-84 and 1-10-85. If he retires on 1-1-86, what pension does he draw per month?
questions.solution: Over the 36 months, salaries are ₹380 for 9 months, ₹420 for 12, ₹460 for 12 and ₹500 for 3. Average = ₹430; pension is half, ₹215.

questions.q: If 70% of a number is 0.35, then find 120% of that number.
A trader marked the price of a commodity to include a profit of 25% but allowed a discount of 16% on the marked price. What will be his actual profit ?
questions.solution: Selling price is 125%×84%=105% of cost. Actual profit is 5%.

questions.q: The batting average for 30 innings of a cricket player is 40 runs. His highest score exceeds his lowest score by 100 runs. If these two innings are not included, the average of the remaining 28 innings is 38 runs. Then the lowest score of the player is:
questions.solution: Total runs = 30×40=1200. Remaining runs = 28×38=1064. Highest and lowest total 136 and differ by 100, so lowest = (136−100)/2=18.

questions.q: A used two-wheeler-dealer sells a scooter for ₹ 460 and makes some loss. If he had sold it for ₹ 580, his profit would have been double of his loss. What was the cost price of the scooter?
questions.solution: Let cost be C. Then 580−C=2(C−460). Solving gives 3C=1500 and C=₹500.

questions.q: Find the HCF of 285, 510, 1440.
questions.solution: The greatest common divisor of 285,510 and 1440 is 15.

questions.q: Find the HCF of $\frac{1}{2}, \frac{2}{3}, \frac{3}{4}, \frac{4}{5}$.
questions.solution: For reduced fractions, HCF = HCF of numerators divided by LCM of denominators. This is 1/LCM(2,3,4,5)=1/60.

questions.q: There are Senior officers and Secretaries in an office. If 15 Secretaries went on leave, then every Secretary has two Senior officers. After that 45 Senior officers went on leave and now every Senior officer has 5 Secretaries. Then find out how many Secretaries were there initially.
questions.solution: Let the remaining secretaries after leave be s. Officers number 2s. After 45 officers leave, s=5(2s−45), giving s=25. Initial secretaries =25+15=40.

questions.q: A boat goes 80 km upstream in 16 hours and 72 km downstream in 12 hours. The speed of the boat in still water is:
questions.solution: Upstream speed =80/16=5; downstream speed =72/12=6. Still-water speed is their average, 5.5 km/h.

questions.q: A person can row $22\frac{1}{2}$ km an hour in still water and he finds that it takes him twice as long to row up as to row down the stream. The speed of the stream is:
questions.solution: Let still-water speed be 22.5 and current be v. Twice the upstream time means 22.5+v=2(22.5−v), giving v=7.5 km/h.

questions.q: A manufacturer undertakes to supply 2000 pieces of a particular component at ₹ 50 per piece. According to his estimates, even if 5% components fail to pass the quality test, then he will make a profit of 25%. However, as it turned out, 50% of the components were rejected. Then what is the loss to the manufacturer ?
questions.solution: Expected saleable units are 1900, producing revenue ₹95,000. Estimated cost is 95000/1.25=₹76,000. Actual revenue from 1000 units is ₹50,000, so loss is ₹26,000.

questions.q: By selling a car for ₹ 6,400, Mr. Rao lost 20%. Then the cost price of the car is:
A sum of money is paid back in two annual instalments of ₹ 1,764 each, allowing 5% compound interest compounded annually. The sum borrowed was:
questions.solution: Discount both instalments to the borrowing date: 1764/1.05+1764/1.05²=1680+1600=₹3280.

questions.q: C and B can do a work in 18 days and 24 days respectively. They worked together for 8 days and then C left. In how many days did B finish the remaining work?
questions.solution: Eight days fill 8(1/18+1/24)=7/9 of the work. Remaining 2/9 takes B 24×2/9=16/3 days.

questions.q: A and B each can do a work in 75 days. They began the work together but A left after some time and B completed the remaining work in 23 days. After how many days of the start of the work did A leave?
questions.solution: B alone completes 23/75 of the work in the final 23 days. The earlier joint work is 52/75. At rate 2/75, this takes 26 days.

questions.q: In what ratio must the two types of tea at ₹180/kg and ₹280/kg respectively be mixed so that the obtained mixture sold at ₹320/kg earns a profit of 20%?
questions.solution: Mixture cost must be 320/1.20=800/3. Alligation gives cheaper:dearer=(280−800/3):(800/3−180)=2:13.

questions.q: The ratio between the speed of travelling of A and B is 2:3 and therefore A takes 15 minutes more than the time taken by B to reach a destination. If A had walked at double the speed, how long would he have taken to cover the distance?
questions.solution: At speeds 2:3, times are 3:2. One time unit is 15 minutes, so A normally takes 45. Doubling A’s speed halves this to 22.5 minutes.

questions.q: If the cost of 6 mangoes is ₹90, what is the cost of 10 mangoes?
questions.solution: Each mango costs 90/6=₹15. Ten cost ₹150.

questions.q: A few students went on a trip and the total amount planned to be spent was ₹96. However, 4 students did not turn up and as a result the remaining students had to contribute ₹4 extra. The number of students who attended the trip was:
questions.solution: Let attendees be n; planned group was n+4. Then 96/n−96/(n+4)=4, giving n(n+4)=96 and positive solution n=8.

questions.q: If you have a regular pentagonal prism and you slice it parallel to its bases, what shape is the cross-section?
questions.solution: A cut parallel to the bases of a prism has the same shape as those bases. A pentagonal prism gives a pentagon.

questions.q: If the speed of a boat moving against the current is 18 km/hr, what is the speed of the stream if the boat's speed downstream is 50% greater than its speed upstream ?
questions.solution: Upstream speed is 18 and downstream is 1.5×18=27. Stream speed is half their difference: (27−18)/2=4.5 km/h.

questions.q: What is the area of a triangle with base 8 meters and height 16 meters ?
questions.solution: Triangle area = base×height/2 =8×16/2=64 m².

questions.q: A man travels the first 200 km of his journey at 80 km/hr. Due to bad weather he travels the next 200 km of his journey at 50 km/hr. What is his average speed for the first 400 km of his journey?
questions.solution: Total time =200/80+200/50=6.5 hours. Average speed =400/6.5≈61.538 km/h, matching 61.53.
